answers.core: Ease of use of the AABB requires that it be built-in.
answers.workaround: Yes, but it depends on the skill level of the user. If they don't know how to get the AABB/Rect2 in script they will become stuck or do it incorrectly. So it's for the best that Godot shaders provide it to prevent headaches and streamline the process.

title: Adding an AABB built-in for Godot shaders
